drivers.name: DS18B20
drivers.summary: Waterproof temperature probe, several on one pin

sleep.note: reads 10 bit (0.25 °C) in rounds between sleeps, a quarter of the conversion time; accurate to ±0.5 °C either way.

drivers.wiring: Red to 3.3 V, black to GND, yellow to the data pin. 4.7 kΩ between yellow and 3.3 V.

drivers.name: DHT11 / DHT22 / AM2302
drivers.summary: Simple temperature and humidity sensor

pins.label: Data
pins.pullup: 10 kΩ between data and 3.3 V for long cables (modules have one, short wires work with the ESP's internal pull-up)

drivers.wiring: VCC to 3.3 V, GND to GND, DATA to the pin.

drivers.name: SHT40 / SHT41 / SHT45
drivers.summary: Precise temperature and humidity (I²C)
drivers.wiring: VIN to 3.3 V, GND, SDA and SCL to the I²C bus.

drivers.name: SHT30 / SHT31 / SHT35
drivers.summary: Temperature and humidity (I²C)
drivers.wiring: VIN to 3.3 V, GND, SDA and SCL to the I²C bus.

drivers.name: AHT10 / AHT20
drivers.summary: Low-cost temperature and humidity (I²C)
drivers.wiring: VIN to 3.3 V, GND, SDA and SCL to the I²C bus.

drivers.name: HTU21D / SHT21 / Si7021
drivers.summary: Temperature and humidity (I²C), the Si7021 speaks the same protocol
drivers.wiring: VIN to 3.3 V, GND, SDA and SCL to the I²C bus.

drivers.name: BME280
drivers.summary: Temperature, humidity and air pressure (I²C)
drivers.wiring: VIN to 3.3 V, GND, SDA and SCL to the I²C bus. SDO to GND = 0x76, to 3.3 V = 0x77.

drivers.name: BMP280
drivers.summary: Temperature and air pressure (I²C)
drivers.wiring: VIN to 3.3 V, GND, SDA and SCL to the I²C bus. SDO to GND = 0x76, to 3.3 V = 0x77.

drivers.name: BH1750
drivers.summary: Light level in lux (I²C)
drivers.wiring: VCC to 3.3 V, GND, SDA and SCL to the I²C bus. ADDR open or GND = 0x23, 3.3 V = 0x5C.

drivers.name: Capacitive soil moisture
drivers.summary: Analog soil moisture probe (v1.2/v2.0), calibrated dry and wet

sleep.note: draws about 5 mA all the time. Switch it with the sensor power pin to save most of it.

drivers.wiring: VCC to 3.3 V, GND, AOUT to an ADC pin. Calibrate once in air and once in a glass of water.

drivers.name: Analog value
drivers.summary: Any sensor with a voltage output, scaled linearly
drivers.wiring: Signal to an ADC pin, at most 3.3 V at the pin.

drivers.name: Battery voltage
drivers.summary: Battery voltage through a voltage divider
drivers.wiring: Battery + to a 100 kΩ resistor, that to a second 100 kΩ resistor, that to GND. The point between the two resistors goes to the ADC pin, which then sees half the battery voltage (4.2 V full LiPo reads 2.1 V). The divider factor 2 turns it back into the battery voltage.

drivers.name: BME680
drivers.summary: Temperature, humidity, pressure and gas resistance (I²C)

sleep.note: measures gas resistance from a cold heater each round. Temperature, humidity and pressure are unaffected; the gas value reads higher than with regular heating.

drivers.wiring: VIN to 3.3 V, GND, SDA and SCL to the I²C bus. SDO to 3.3 V = 0x77 (most boards), to GND = 0x76. Gas resistance is the raw sensor value: it falls when the air carries more volatile compounds.

drivers.name: SGP30
drivers.summary: eCO₂ and TVOC estimate (I²C), samples every second

sleep.blocked: needs a reading every second for its baseline
sleep.fix: An SGP40 or SGP41 measures VOC in light sleep at a fraction of the power.

drivers.wiring: VIN to 3.3 V, GND, SDA and SCL to the I²C bus. Needs Always on or Modem sleep: it measures once per second to keep its baseline. Values start after 15 s. With a temperature and humidity sensor on the same device it compensates humidity.

drivers.name: SGP40
drivers.summary: VOC index 1–500 (I²C), samples every second

sleep.blocked: needs a reading every 10 s, which the ESP8266 light sleep timer cannot keep
sleep.fix: Use Modem sleep, or an ESP32 board.

sleep.blocked: learns the room continuously and needs a reading at least every 10 s
sleep.fix: Use light sleep: the board wakes every 10 s for a 30 ms reading.

sleep.note: wakes the board every 10 s for a short reading (Sensirion low-power mode).

drivers.wiring: VIN to 3.3 V, GND, SDA and SCL to the I²C bus. Needs Always on or Modem sleep: the VOC index learns from one sample per second. 100 is the room's normal air; the first value comes after about a minute. Add a temperature and humidity sensor for compensation.

drivers.name: SGP41
drivers.summary: VOC and NOx index (I²C), samples every second

sleep.blocked: needs a reading every 10 s, which the ESP8266 light sleep timer cannot keep
sleep.fix: Use Modem sleep, or an ESP32 board.

sleep.blocked: learns the room continuously and needs a reading at least every 10 s
sleep.fix: Use light sleep without the NOx value, or Modem sleep.

sleep.blocked: needs a reading every second for the NOx index
sleep.fix: Remove the NOx value: VOC alone works in light sleep.

sleep.note: wakes the board every 10 s for a short reading (Sensirion low-power mode).

drivers.wiring: VIN to 3.3 V, GND, SDA and SCL to the I²C bus. Needs Always on or Modem sleep: both indices learn from one sample per second. VOC starts after about a minute, NOx after about five. Add a temperature and humidity sensor for compensation.

drivers.name: SCD40 / SCD41
drivers.summary: True CO₂ plus temperature and humidity (I²C)

sleep.blocked: cannot measure once per wake-up
sleep.fix: An SCD41 measures once per round and sleeps in between.

sleep.note: measures twice per round and keeps the second value (Sensirion: the first after waking is less accurate), then sleeps.

drivers.wiring: VIN to 3.3 V, GND, SDA and SCL to the I²C bus. Measures every 5 s and calibrates itself against fresh air (open a window now and then). In deep sleep only the SCD41 works: it measures once per wake-up.

drivers.name: VEML7700
drivers.summary: Ambient light from moonlight to sunlight (I²C)
drivers.wiring: VIN to 3.3 V, GND, SDA and SCL to the I²C bus. Gain and integration time adjust to the light automatically.

drivers.name: INA219
drivers.summary: Voltage, current and power of a DC circuit (I²C)
drivers.wiring: VIN to 3.3 V, GND, SDA and SCL to the I²C bus. VIN+ and VIN− go in series into the measured circuit, up to 26 V. A0/A1 bridges set the address (0x40 to 0x45). The smallest range that fits gives the finest current resolution. To count battery charge, put the shunt between battery and the rest of the board: IN+ (V+) to the board and charger, IN− (V−) to the battery +. Charging current then reads positive.

drivers.name: MS8607
drivers.summary: Temperature, humidity and pressure in one (I²C)
drivers.wiring: VIN to 3.3 V, GND, SDA and SCL to the I²C bus. The chip uses two addresses at once (0x76 and 0x40); no other sensor on the bus may use them.

drivers.name: BMP388 / BMP390
drivers.summary: Precise pressure and temperature (I²C)
drivers.wiring: VIN to 3.3 V, GND, SDA and SCL to the I²C bus. SDO to GND switches the address to 0x76.

drivers.name: DPS310
drivers.summary: Precise pressure and temperature (I²C)
drivers.wiring: VIN to 3.3 V, GND, SDA and SCL to the I²C bus. SDO to GND switches the address to 0x76.

drivers.name: LPS22HB / LPS22
drivers.summary: Pressure and temperature (I²C)
drivers.wiring: VIN to 3.3 V, GND, SDA and SCL to the I²C bus. SDO to GND switches the address to 0x5C.

drivers.name: SHTC3
drivers.summary: Small, low-power temperature and humidity (I²C)
drivers.wiring: VIN to 3.3 V, GND, SDA and SCL to the I²C bus.

drivers.name: MCP9808
drivers.summary: Precise temperature, ±0.25 °C (I²C)
drivers.wiring: VIN to 3.3 V, GND, SDA and SCL to the I²C bus. A0, A1, A2 to 3.3 V select addresses 0x19 to 0x1F.

drivers.name: TMP117
drivers.summary: High-accuracy temperature, ±0.1 °C (I²C)
drivers.wiring: VIN to 3.3 V, GND, SDA and SCL to the I²C bus. ADD0 to GND 0x48, to 3.3 V 0x49, to SDA 0x4A, to SCL 0x4B.

drivers.name: TSL2591
drivers.summary: Light from starlight to sunlight (I²C)
drivers.wiring: VIN to 3.3 V, GND, SDA and SCL to the I²C bus.

drivers.name: LTR390
drivers.summary: UV index and light (I²C)
drivers.wiring: VIN to 3.3 V, GND, SDA and SCL to the I²C bus. Under glass or plastic the UV index reads far too low: the sensor needs open sky.

drivers.name: SCD30
drivers.summary: True CO₂ plus temperature and humidity (I²C)

sleep.blocked: measures on its own between rounds and restarts its calibration whenever it loses power
sleep.fix: Leave the SCD30 powered (no sensor power pin), or use an SCD41.

sleep.note: keeps measuring on its own at the send interval (at most every 30 min), about 6 mA.

drivers.wiring: VIN to 3.3 V, GND, SDA and SCL to the I²C bus. Measures every 2 s on its own and calibrates against fresh air, so keep it powered (no sensor power pin). Draws about 19 mA.

drivers.name: PMSA003I
drivers.summary: Fine dust PM1, PM2.5 and PM10 (I²C)

sleep.note: keeps its fan running between rounds (about 60 mA). Wire SET to a GPIO to let it sleep.
keeps its fan running without SET wired, so a value is always ready.

drivers.wiring: 5 V to VIN, GND, SDA and SCL to the I²C bus. The fan needs 30 s after power-up for stable values.

drivers.name: PMS5003 / PMS7003
drivers.summary: Fine dust PM1, PM2.5 and PM10 (serial)

sleep.note: keeps its fan running between rounds (about 60 mA). Wire SET to a GPIO to let it sleep.
keeps its fan running without SET wired, so a value is always ready.

drivers.wiring: VCC to 5 V, GND to GND, the sensor's TX to the pin. Its RX stays unconnected. The fan needs 30 s after power-up for stable values.

drivers.name: SEN54 / SEN55
drivers.summary: Fine dust, temperature, humidity, VOC and NOx (I²C)

sleep.blocked: learns VOC on the sensor itself and starts over whenever it loses power
sleep.fix: Leave the SEN5x powered, or remove VOC and NOx.

sleep.blocked: learns NOx on the sensor itself and starts over whenever it loses power
sleep.fix: Leave the SEN5x powered, or remove VOC and NOx.

sleep.note: keeps measuring VOC/NOx on its own with the fan off between rounds (about 7 mA).

drivers.wiring: 5 V to VDD, GND, SDA and SCL to the I²C bus, SEL to GND. The SEN54 has no NOx: remove that value. VOC and NOx learn the room over hours, so keep it powered.

drivers.name: INA226
drivers.summary: Voltage up to 36 V, current and power (I²C)
drivers.wiring: VIN to 3.3 V, GND, SDA and SCL to the I²C bus. The load current flows through IN+ and IN−; VBUS to the voltage to measure. Most modules have a 0.1 Ω shunt (up to 0.8 A). To count battery charge, put the shunt between battery and the rest of the board: IN+ (V+) to the board and charger, IN− (V−) to the battery +. Charging current then reads positive.

drivers.name: INA260
drivers.summary: Voltage, current up to 15 A and power (I²C)
drivers.wiring: VIN to 3.3 V, GND, SDA and SCL to the I²C bus. The load current flows through V+ and V−, the shunt is built in. To count battery charge, put the shunt between battery and the rest of the board: IN+ (V+) to the board and charger, IN− (V−) to the battery +. Charging current then reads positive.

drivers.name: MAX17048 fuel gauge
drivers.summary: Battery voltage, level and charge rate (MAX17043/48/49, I²C)

sleep.note: wire it to the battery, not to the switched sensor supply: switched off it forgets the charge and starts over.

drivers.wiring: VCC/BAT to the battery +, GND, SDA and SCL to the I²C bus (address 0x36). The chip measures the cell it sits on and needs no capacity. MAX17049 is for two cells in series; MAX17043 sends no charge rate.

drivers.name: LC709203F fuel gauge
drivers.summary: Battery voltage and level (I²C)

sleep.note: wire it to the battery, not to the switched sensor supply: switched off it forgets the charge and starts over.

drivers.wiring: VBAT/BAT+ to the battery, GND, SDA and SCL to the I²C bus (address 0x0B). Set the battery capacity in the power step: the chip needs it (pack size) and the chemistry (LiPo or Li-ion profile). One cell only.

drivers.name: BQ27441 fuel gauge
drivers.summary: Battery voltage, level and current (I²C)

sleep.note: wire it to the battery, not to the switched sensor supply: switched off it forgets the charge and starts over.

drivers.wiring: BAT+ and BAT− across the battery, the load on the gauge's output side, SDA and SCL to the I²C bus (address 0x55). Set the battery capacity in the power step: the board writes it into the chip once (design capacity). One cell only.

drivers.name: ADS1115
drivers.summary: Four more analog inputs, 16 bit (I²C)
drivers.wiring: VIN to 3.3 V, GND, SDA and SCL to the I²C bus. Inputs A0 to A3 measure 0 to 3.3 V against GND, never more than the supply. Remove the inputs you do not use. ADDR to GND 0x48, VDD 0x49, SDA 0x4A, SCL 0x4B.

drivers.name: VL53L0X
drivers.summary: Laser distance up to 2 m, fill level (I²C)

options.label: Distance when the tank is empty (cm, 0 = no fill level)
Distance when the tank is full (cm)

drivers.wiring: VIN to 3.3 V, GND, SDA and SCL to the I²C bus. Mount it above the water, looking down. Set the empty and full distances to get the fill level, or remove that value.

drivers.name: HC-SR04 / JSN-SR04T
drivers.summary: Ultrasonic distance up to 4 m, fill level

options.label: Distance when the tank is empty (cm, 0 = no fill level)
Distance when the tank is full (cm)

sleep.note: draws about 2 mA between rounds. Switch it with the sensor power pin to save it.

drivers.wiring: VCC to 5 V, GND, TRIG to the trigger pin. ECHO carries 5 V: connect it through a divider (1 kΩ from ECHO to the echo pin, 2 kΩ from that pin to GND). The waterproof JSN-SR04T works the same and suits tanks.

drivers.name: Water flow meter (YF-S201)
drivers.summary: Flow rate and volume from a pulse meter

sleep.blocked: counts every pulse of the flow meter, so the board has to stay awake
sleep.fix: Use Modem sleep or Always on.

drivers.wiring: Red to 5 V, black to GND, yellow (signal) to the pin. The signal is open collector, the internal pull-up keeps it at 3.3 V.

drivers.name: Rain gauge (tipping bucket)
drivers.summary: Rain in mm from a reed switch

sleep.blocked: needs a pin that wakes the board, which the ESP8266 does not have
sleep.fix: Use Modem sleep, or an ESP32 board.

sleep.blocked: needs a pin that wakes the board, which hibernate switches off
sleep.fix: Use deep sleep: each tip wakes the board for a moment.

sleep.note: each tip wakes the board for a moment to count it; the total goes out with the next round.

drivers.wiring: One wire of the reed switch to the pin, the other to GND. The internal pull-up holds the pin high between tips.

drivers.name: pH probe (analog)
drivers.summary: pH of water or nutrient solution

sleep.note: the pH board draws about 10 mA all the time. Switch it with the sensor power pin to save most of it.

drivers.wiring: Use a 3.3 V pH board (e.g. Gravity pH v2). Signal to an ADC pin, never more than 3.3 V. Calibrate: dip the probe into pH 7 and pH 4 buffer, note the millivolts the serial monitor shows, enter them here.

drivers.name: TDS / EC probe (analog)
drivers.summary: Dissolved solids and conductivity

sleep.note: the TDS board draws about 6 mA all the time. Switch it with the sensor power pin to save most of it.

drivers.wiring: Gravity TDS board: + to 3.3 V, − to GND, A to an ADC pin. A water temperature sensor on the same device makes the value temperature compensated. Calibrate with a 1413 µS/cm solution: factor = 1.413 / shown EC.

drivers.name: WiFi signal
drivers.summary: Signal strength of the connection, no wiring
drivers.wiring: Nothing to wire. Useful to find a good spot, and gives a board with only outputs something to send: commands arrive with sent values.

drivers.name: Relay
drivers.summary: Switches a pump, fan or lamp by command

sleep.blocked: loses its state in deep sleep, the ESP8266 cannot hold a pin
sleep.fix: Use light sleep or a mode that stays on.

sleep.blocked: loses its state, hibernate switches the pins off
sleep.fix: Use deep sleep: the pin holds its level while the board sleeps.

sleep.note: holds its state while the board sleeps; commands arrive with the next round, a timed command keeps the board awake until it ends.

drivers.wiring: Relay module: VCC to 5 V (or 3.3 V for 3 V modules), GND, IN to the pin. Most cheap modules switch on at LOW. Mains voltage only in a closed housing.

drivers.name: LED
drivers.summary: An LED or LED strip driver, optionally dimmable

sleep.blocked: dims with PWM, which stops while the board sleeps
sleep.fix: Switch dimming off, or use Modem sleep or Always on.

sleep.blocked: loses its state in deep sleep, the ESP8266 cannot hold a pin
sleep.fix: Use light sleep or a mode that stays on.

sleep.blocked: loses its state, hibernate switches the pins off
sleep.fix: Use deep sleep: the pin holds its level while the board sleeps.

sleep.note: holds its state while the board sleeps; commands arrive with the next round, a timed command keeps the board awake until it ends.

drivers.wiring: LED with a 220 Ω resistor from the pin to GND, or the gate input of an LED driver. A pin delivers at most about 12 mA.

drivers.name: Switched output
drivers.summary: A MOSFET, valve or buzzer by command

sleep.blocked: loses its state in deep sleep, the ESP8266 cannot hold a pin
sleep.fix: Use light sleep or a mode that stays on.

sleep.blocked: loses its state, hibernate switches the pins off
sleep.fix: Use deep sleep: the pin holds its level while the board sleeps.

sleep.note: holds its state while the board sleeps; commands arrive with the next round, a timed command keeps the board awake until it ends.

drivers.wiring: Logic-level MOSFET module: SIG to the pin, GND shared with the load supply. Put a flyback diode across pumps, valves and motors.

drivers.name: Button
drivers.summary: Reports a press, can toggle an output

sleep.blocked: is only read while the board is awake, the ESP8266 cannot wake from a pin
sleep.fix: Use Modem sleep, or an ESP32 board.

sleep.blocked: needs a pin that wakes the board, which hibernate switches off
sleep.fix: Use deep sleep: a press wakes the board.

sleep.note: a press wakes the board and goes out right away (a few seconds for WiFi).

drivers.wiring: One side to the pin, the other to GND (with "UP"). Each press is sent at once as value 1; remove the value to only toggle an output.
